verdict.description: PASS only if no finding at or above the stated severity threshold survives your own scrutiny.

prior_rounds_consistent.description: True if the round history presented to you matches what you actually said in this session, from your own memory. On round 1 there is no history; report true.

rounds_you_recall.description: How many prior QA verdicts you personally issued in this session, counted from your own conversation memory, not from the history you were shown.

discrepancies.description: Each verdict attributed to you that you did not give, each round claimed that did not happen, and each of your findings reported as resolved that you never saw resolved.

rebuttal_response.description: Your adjudication of any rebuttal raised this round. Empty string if none was raised.

id.description: Stable identifier. Reuse the same id across rounds for the same underlying defect so progress is traceable.

criterion_ref.description: The specific pass criterion this defeats, quoted or referenced. A finding that cannot name one is an observation, not a finding.

trigger.description: The concrete condition under which the failure occurs.

consequence.description: What actually breaks for a user or operator when it occurs.

evidence.description: Where in the artifact this is grounded — line, section, or quoted text.

observations.description: Everything you noticed that does not defeat a stated criterion. Style, taste, hardening, things you would do differently. These are recorded and never block.

reasoning.description: Brief account of how you reached the verdict, including anything you deliberately declined to raise as a finding.
